notes: Nothing gets lost: The backup taken before every update now includes the whole Litter Box (every model’s fake-money bets, risk-level copies and results), the learning loop and your encrypted key vault — next to your trade history and settings. Your layout and display choices (sections, text size, theme, chosen cats) are also kept in your own data folder, so they come back by themselves if the app window’s storage is ever cleared. Each part of the page now draws on its own: if one part ever fails, your balance, account and updates still show.
